evals.name: client-testimonial-finder-eval-1
evals.expected_output: Quotable: the nine days to four days close time, and the support team is the reason they renewed. Not usable: the rep line about the whole team (the customer narrowed it to finance), 'it is fine', the conditional integration line, and the off-the-record price line. Permission: the customer said maybe and asked for the exact wording first. Best: close time first, support second.
expectations: Every section in the rubric is present, in order
Every claim cites a quote, a timestamp, or a column and cell
Anything the input does not say is written as not stated, not guessed
No fact from outside the input appears
A rep claim that the other side never accepted is not written as agreed
The close-time quote and the support quote are listed as quotable
The off-the-record price line is listed as not usable and is not quoted as a testimonial
The conditional integration line is listed as not usable
The permission section records that the customer asked for the exact wording first

evals.name: client-testimonial-finder-eval-2-thin-input
evals.prompt: run client-testimonial-finder on a very short input that supports only one or two items
evals.expected_output: The output is short and does not invent items to fill the sections. Missing items are written as not stated.
expectations: The output does not pad to reach a count
Missing information is written as not stated
